what: seal run 2, operation E, first attempt: KILLED. Defect of the seal script, not of the harness: E was funded for 58.8 s (the $0.50 run cap / the guard's $0.0085/s bound), too short for entry 7's apt step plus its pip install of the era lock; the client stopped the pip step and the script did not catch SandboxTimeoutError, so the measured cost of the completed steps (upload/extract, apt) was lost with the exception.
message: sandbox execution exceeded 58.8235294117647s wall clock: Operation 01a0f82a-ee6d-76bc-a8f0-f74e11c7246f has timed out

killed_operation.source: GET /v1/operations/{id} (free per the Contree MCP cheatsheet), read after the kill
killed_operation.command: printf '%s\n' <entry 7's 19-line era lock + gcc> > .rerun-requirements.txt && pip install -r .rerun-requirements.txt

kept_image_from_this_attempt: 81809b90-f48d-4ba3-9ae2-51081ee3cf68 (the image the killed pip step ran on: tree + apt step; disposable=false, kept on timeout)

cost.reason_no_measurement: the completed steps' costs were carried by the exception the script did not catch; the SDK has no call that lists past operations, and the cancelled operation reports no cost
cost.estimated_upper_bound_basis: the whole operation's funded time, 58.8 s, at the guard's bound $0.0085/s (cost_guard.SANDBOX_COST_RATE_USD_PER_S)
